name: motion-graphics-skills
description: Creative direction, storyboards, code-driven animation, media preparation and video review for motion graphics.

interface.longDescription: Plan brand films, event promos, explainers and kinetic typography. Study references, write production briefs, prepare assets, build code-driven animation and review timecoded cuts. Includes Arabic and RTL guidance. Rendering requires an execution-capable host, installed runtime dependencies and available media. This skills-only plugin does not include a hosted renderer, connected media service or API credentials. Use motion-studio to start and motion-director for broader production jobs.
defaultPrompt: Plan a 30-second Arabic brand film from my script and visual reference.
Build a code-driven motion sequence from my approved storyboard.
Review my video and give me timecoded fixes for typography, pacing and transitions.
